exits.notes: Separated from Uber effective 2019-07-31 under a separation agreement. Reason, verbatim: the 8-K says he and the CMO 'will be leaving the Company' as part of 'a number of leadership and organizational changes'; the proxy says he 'separated from Uber'. No filing says resigned or terminated, so exit_type is 'other'. The 2020 proxy reports his actual package on its 'Involuntary termination (non-CIC)' row (footnote 7 describes the agreement): Salary $500,000, Bonus $1,000,000, Continued Benefits $0, Other Supplemental Benefit $1,100,000, Equity Acceleration $3,130,749, Total $5,730,749 (total_exit_pay as stated there). severance_cash is null because the filing prints cash severance only as separate Salary ($500,000) and Bonus ($1,000,000) cells; together they are $1,500,000, consistent with the $125,000 monthly installments for 12 months. The loader requires each recorded figure to appear in a quote, so the sum is not recorded. other_exit_pay = the 'Other Supplemental Benefit' cell; the filings don't say what it consists of. accelerated_equity_value = the row's Equity Acceleration cell; footnote 7 describes the equity benefit as 12 months of vesting on his 2018-01-30 RSU grant. The table values accelerations at the $29.74 2019-12-31 close 'unless otherwise noted', and no other date is noted for him. Agreement terms: '$1,725,000 in 2019', plus '$125,000 per month through July 16, 2020' subject to confidentiality, cooperation and non-disparagement covenants. The FY2019 SCT All Other ($1,771,892) includes '$625,000' of the cash severance and '$1,000,000' of supplemental benefits (see conflicts on $1.0M vs $1.1M). Separately, his FY2019 SCT bonus of $583,333 is 'a prorated bonus based on time worked' paid 'Per Mr. Harford's separation agreement'. The filings don't say whether it is part of the $5,730,749. His 2019 equity grant ($4,960,845 grant-date value) was forfeited.

Stepped down as Chief Product Officer 2019-12-13 (the officer-tenure end in the exec comp file). Employment ended 2020-01-10, the date used here. Reason, verbatim: 'Mr. Gupta terminated his employment with Uber and is not eligible for the 2019 year-end bonus'. The 2021 proxy uses the same construction for Pham, who 'resigned', but no filing says Gupta resigned or was terminated, so exit_type is 'other'. No 8-K was filed and no filing reports any separation payment. The only quantification is the 2020 proxy's hypothetical 'Involuntary termination (non-CIC)' row as of 2019-12-31: Salary $500,000, Bonus $375,000, Continued Benefits $0, Other Supplemental Benefit $0, Equity Acceleration $3,814,125, Total $4,689,125 (recorded as basis 'estimated', total as stated). His grandfathered terms pay this only on a termination 'by us without cause or by him for good reason'. If he left voluntarily, these amounts would not have been payable. His outstanding-award footnotes say his RSUs vest only 'had Mr. Gupta remained in continuous service with us'. severance_cash is null because the filing prints Salary and Bonus cells separately ($875,000 together).

Reason, verbatim: on 2020-04-24 he 'notified the Company of his intention to resign ... effective as of May 16, 2020' (8-K); 2021 proxy: 'Mr. Pham resigned effective May 16, 2020' and 'was not eligible for the 2020 annual cash bonus'. The 2021 proxy says 'No benefits are payable pursuant to our Executive Severance Plan in the event of an NEO's voluntary resignation or retirement', and his FY2020 SCT row shows $0 bonus and $0 All Other Compensation, so severance_cash and other_exit_pay are 0 (actual). No filing addresses his unvested equity or any post-departure consulting arrangement, so those stay null and total_exit_pay is not set.

Ceased as CFO 2023-11-08 (officer-tenure end). Stayed as an employee to help with the transition until his employment 'was terminated on January 5, 2024', the date used here. Reason, verbatim: 'involuntary termination without cause (outside of a change in control period)', a 'qualifying termination' under the Executive Severance Plan. The August 2023 8-K said he 'will leave the Company on January 5, 2024'. The 2024 proxy table 'reflects the actual payments received': Salary $925,000, Bonus $925,000, Continued Benefits $26,172 (12 months of medical and dental premiums, recorded as other_exit_pay), Equity Acceleration $26,523,816, Total $28,399,989 (total_exit_pay as stated). severance_cash is null because the filing prints Salary and Bonus cells separately ($1,850,000 together, i.e. 12 months' salary plus a 100% target bonus). The loader requires each recorded figure to appear verbatim. Equity is valued at the $63.65 close on 2024-01-16 (RSUs) and the $78.41 close on 2024-02-16 (PRSUs, including his 2021 PRSUs at actual performance). He got no 2023 annual bonus payout, and his market-cap-conditioned awards were 'forfeited for no consideration'.

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026: DEF 14A 2020-03-30 (FY2019), 2021-03-29 (FY2020), 2022-03-28 (FY2021), 2023-03-28 (FY2022), 2024-03-25 (FY2023), 2025-03-24 (FY2024) and 2026-03-23 (FY2025). One row per (filing, director), dashes recorded as 0. Uber filed no proxy in 2019 (IPO May 2019) and no 10-K/A, so FY2018 comes from the IPO prospectus (424B4, 2019-05-13). The S-1 and S-1/A print the identical FY2018 table and are not recorded separately. Checked and not recorded: the 2025 DEFR14A (XBRL tagging only, no table); the 2026 DEFR14A (reprints the FY2025 table identically); the 2021 and 2024 PRE 14As (tables identical to the definitive ones); every DEFA14A 2020-2026 (no director table). Khosrowshahi, the only employee director, is never in the table. Each table covers the calendar fiscal year.

Every NEO in uber_exec_comp_research.json whose officer tenure ended: Harford, Gupta, Pham, Chai, Mahendra-Rajah, Krishnamurthy. Hazelbaker is excluded: her positions ended only through title changes and she is still an officer. Khosrowshahi, West and Macdonald are current. Sources: the proxy after each departure (SCT All Other footnotes, bonus tables, the 2024 'CFO Transition' section, Potential Payments tables and their footnotes), the Item 5.02 8-Ks, and the 10-K/10-Q exhibit indexes (no separation agreement was filed as an exhibit). Submissions feed reviewed through 2026-09-21. exit_date is the date employment ended where a filing states it (Gupta 2020-01-10, Chai 2024-01-05), otherwise the officer step-down date. Uber prints cash severance as separate Salary and Bonus cells. The loader requires each recorded figure to appear verbatim in a quote, so severance_cash is left null in those cases, the parts are given in notes, and total_exit_pay is the filing's own Total. 'estimated' rows are Potential Payments hypotheticals.
